title: Lanthanoid pyridyl-β-diketonate ‘triangles’. New examples of single molecule toroics

synthesis.procedure: o-dppdH (0.317 g, 0.0014 mol) was dissolved in dry methanol (40 mL), triethylamine (0.2 mL) was added dropwise, and DyCl3·6H2O (0.0007 mol) was added. The mixture was refluxed for 48 h. Solvent was removed, the solid was taken up in acetonitrile (40 mL) and centrifuged, the insoluble solid was dissolved in pyridine (40 mL) and centrifuged, and the solution was evaporated and washed with diethyl ether (20 mL × 3). Crystals for X-ray analysis were grown by slow evaporation of a methanol solution over one week. Yield 0.210 g (19.7%).
synthesis.vessel_or_method: reflux in dry methanol, then centrifugation work-up
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Acetonitrile then pyridine extraction with centrifugation; diethyl ether wash; slow evaporation of methanol over one week.

properties.summary: Room-temperature χMT is close to three uncoupled Dy(III) ions and falls more rapidly at low temperature, consistent with Stark/Zeeman depopulation and weak antiferromagnetic coupling. Magnetisation at 2 K does not saturate at 5 T and lacks the low-field S-shape often associated with toroidal ground states. AC data show frequency-dependent out-of-phase susceptibility below 8 K without maxima, so an effective barrier was not extracted. Ab initio analysis predicts a circular anisotropy arrangement and a non-magnetic toroidal ground state.

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the shared procedure: o-dppdH (0.317 g, 0.0014 mol) in dry methanol (40 mL) was deprotonated with triethylamine (0.2 mL), TbCl3·6H2O (0.0007 mol) was added, and the mixture was refluxed for 48 h. After acetonitrile/pyridine centrifugation work-up and diethyl ether washing, crystals were grown by slow diffusion of hexane into an ethanol solution over one week. Yield 0.177 g (15.0%). The crystal contains two independent triangles that differ in terminal H2O/ethanol ligation.

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Acetonitrile then pyridine extraction; diethyl ether wash; slow hexane diffusion into ethanol over one week.

properties.summary: χMT at 300 K is consistent with six Tb(III) ions in the crystallographic formula unit as reported for complex 2 (33.4 cm^3 mol^-1 K). Low-temperature decrease is attributed to depopulation and possible weak antiferromagnetic coupling. Magnetisation does not saturate at 5 T and 2 K. AC measurements give only weak, noisy χ'' without frequency-dependent maxima. Theory finds that one Tb anisotropy axis is perpendicular to the triangle, so a toroidal spin state is not supported.

synthesis.procedure: The paper states that complex 3 was also prepared by a previously published procedure, and gives the same general method used for the series: o-dppdH (0.317 g, 0.0014 mol) in dry methanol (40 mL), triethylamine (0.2 mL), and HoCl3·6H2O (0.0007 mol), refluxed for 48 h, followed by acetonitrile/pyridine centrifugation and diethyl ether washing. X-ray crystals were obtained by slow evaporation of methanol over one week. Yield 0.181 g (16.8%). Relative to the earlier analogue, this structure has additional coordinated/lattice water and one fewer chloride.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: reflux in dry methanol, then centrifugation work-up
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Acetonitrile then pyridine extraction; diethyl ether wash; slow evaporation of methanol over one week.

properties.summary: Room-temperature χMT (39.6 cm^3 mol^-1 K) matches a prior structural analogue. The low-temperature drop is assigned to Stark/Zeeman depopulation and possible weak antiferromagnetic coupling. Magnetisation at 2 K and 5 T is unsaturated. AC χ'' is weak and noisy with no clear frequency-dependent maxima. Theory predicts a circular ground-state anisotropy and a non-magnetic toroidal arrangement.

properties.summary: χMT at 300 K is consistent with three Er(III) ions. Magnetisation does not saturate at 2 K and 5 T. AC susceptibility is weak and noisy with no clear frequency-dependent maxima. Because the Er(III) ions are prolate and the calculated g tensors have large transverse anisotropy, a toroidal spin arrangement is not supported.

synthesis.procedure: A second fully refined erbium crystallisation from the same synthetic series. The shared procedure uses o-dppdH (0.317 g, 0.0014 mol), triethylamine (0.2 mL) and ErCl3·6H2O (0.0007 mol) in dry methanol, reflux for 48 h, then acetonitrile/pyridine work-up. The paper describes 4a as illustrating variable solvation between crystallisations. The deposited formula C39H47Cl4Er3N6O17 (CCDC 2022330) matches the aqua cluster [Er3(OH)2(o-dppd)3Cl2(H2O)4]Cl2·5H2O rather than a methanol solvate. No separate yield is given.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: reflux in dry methanol, then centrifugation work-up
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Same series work-up; crystals of the more highly hydrated aqua form were refined separately from the methanol solvate 4.
